subject.title: [Bug]: Discord media uploads lose content-type and animated images lose frames

question: Should the active Discord media PR be refreshed and narrowed around the existing owner boundary, or should maintainers replace it with a new fix that avoids the disputed SDK/media-contract changes?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the open PR's remaining blockers involve public SDK surface and preserved-media delivery behavior that automation cannot choose safely for maintainers.

options.title: Refresh and narrow the linked PR
options.body: Rebase or replace the active branch on current main, keep the fix in Discord/media upload handling unless a broader SDK contract is approved, and require live Discord proof before merge.

options.title: Approve the broader media contract
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept public preserve options and fail-closed oversized preserved media, but the PR should document and prove that behavior before merge.

options.title: Replace with a fresh narrow PR
options.body: If the active branch is too stale or broad, keep this issue open and land a smaller replacement that credits the original report and contribution.

recommendation.title: Refresh and narrow the linked PR
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace the active branch on current main, keep the fix in Discord/media upload handling unless a broader SDK contract is approved, and require live Discord proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history across the Discord send, media, and plugin SDK boundary surfaces involved in this decision.
